title: Monotonicity of Clean Runs
statement: Let $D$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols, initial state $q$, input word $V$, and Boolean output $b$. Suppose there is a time $T$ at which the machine has halted, output exactly the one-symbol word $[b]$, and has blank contents on every work tape with every work-tape head at the origin; suppose also that every work-tape head, at every time $t\le T$, has absolute position at most $B$. If $B\le B'$, then the same machine has a clean run with bound $B'$.
hypotheses_covered: machine D and its state and Boolean-symbol types

all work-tape heads are at zero at T
every head position through time T has absolute value at most B
